children: By Staff Writer
UAE’s GJ Properties expects to hand over approximately 1,500 units in 2026 and a further 1,500–2,000 units in 2027 across its projects in Ajman, CEO Ali Jaber told Zawya Projects.

The company’s development pipeline in the emirate comprises 14 projects with around 8,600 units and a combined development value of 9 billion UAE dirhams ($2.45 billion). These include individual buildings and larger developments containing multiple towers.

“Ajman’s key proposition is affordable luxury combined with a lower cost of living,” said Jaber. “It allows families to purchase quality homes while keeping their overall household expenses manageable.”
For investors, accessible purchase prices and demand from residents support the investment proposition, he added.
“Our focus is on developing homes that people want to occupy and retain over the long term,” Jaber said.

image.alt: Rendering of a residential building within Al Ameera Village project in Ajman. Image courtesy: G J Properties/Story PR

children: G J Properties is also seeking additional land in Al Aamra and Al Yasmeen as part of plans to expand its residential portfolio in Ajman, he disclosed.
Interview excerpts:
What is driving residential demand in Ajman?
Demand is being driven by affordability alongside an improving residential offering. Buyers want quality homes with practical layouts and amenities at prices that fit their household budgets.
At GJ Properties, approximately 60 percent of our buyers are end users and 40 percent are investors. This demonstrates the importance of people purchasing homes for their own use.
Our selling prices have increased by approximately 25 percent over the past 12 months, reflecting the strong demand and limited available supply we are experiencing.
For wider market context, Ajman recorded 6,815 real estate transactions worth more than AED10.8 billion ($2.94 billion) in the first half of 2026.
Could you provide key details and timelines for Sky Gardens Tower, Infinity Towers, ONE 678 Residences and Ameera Phase 6 that were recently showcased at the Ajman Real Estate Investment Exhibition?

Sky Gardens Tower has a development value of AED600 million ($163.38 million) and comprises 400 units. Construction is approximately 20 percent complete, with piling and foundation works finished. Completion is expected in the third quarter of 2028. The sales launch is planned for October 2026.

Infinity Towers is also valued at AED600 million ($163.38 million) and comprises 400 units. Construction is approximately 20 percent complete, with piling and foundation works finished. Completion is expected by the end of 2028, with the sales launch planned for November 2026.

ONE 678 Residences has a development value of AED650 million ($176.99) million and comprises 500 units. Basement and foundation works have been completed, and construction has reached the ground-floor level. Completion is expected by the end of 2028. Approximately 15 percent of the units were sold within the first month of launch.

Ameera Phase 6 is valued at AED800 million ($217.84 million) and comprises 1,200 units. Piling and foundation works have been completed, with project completion expected by the end of 2028. The sales launch is planned for the fourth quarter of 2026.
How are infrastructure improvements supporting Ajman’s property market?
Ajman has seen substantial infrastructure improvements, including bridges, tunnels, road widening and improved access to Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road, E311, and Emirates Road, E611.
These improvements strengthen connectivity within Ajman and with neighbouring emirates, supporting the appeal of its residential areas and opening up locations for further development.
Are you planning further land acquisitions?

We are targeting additional land in Al Aamra and Al Yasmeen. Their suburban locations and access to E311 and E611 make them attractive areas for future residential development, with connections to the wider UAE.
How have construction material costs changed, and what is your outlook for 2027?
Our construction material costs have increased by approximately 15% over the past 12 months. We expect further increases in 2027, reflecting the potential impact of regional developments on costs.
Do you also expect tender prices to increase?
We expect contractors’ tender prices to continue rising in 2027. This makes disciplined budgeting, procurement and project planning increasingly important.
What is your outlook for Ajman’s off-plan market in 2027?
We remain positive about Ajman’s off-plan market in 2027. Improving connectivity, affordable purchase prices and competitive rents should continue to attract residents and support demand.

Etihad Rail has scheduled the opening of Sharjah’s University City station for 30 March 2027. We believe access to the wider passenger rail network could further strengthen Ajman’s appeal, particularly for residents travelling between emirates.

From our perspective, launches and sales remain active. ONE 678 Residences achieved approximately 15 percent sales within its first month, and we are bringing additional developments to market in phases. We expect performance to vary according to location, pricing, construction progress and the quality of each development.
How has the previously announced AED4 billion investment allocation been deployed?

Investment to date has been directed towards ONE 678 Residences, Sky Gardens and Infinity Towers. We plan to deploy further capital in the near future, with additional land acquisitions forming part of our expansion plans.
What are your expansion and diversification plans?
Our immediate expansion focus is on strengthening our residential portfolio in Ajman, including further land acquisitions in Al Aamra and Al Yasmeen.
Alongside residential development, our diversification into hospitality includes the Biltmore Hotel & Residences on Sheikh Zayed Road in Dubai.
Our priority is to deliver our existing pipeline while pursuing opportunities that fit our focus on quality, value and long-term demand.
